source_full: Two rooms were prepared, with pieces of material, scissors, needles and threads, And each young man was shut up in one of them. The king felt rather curious as to what sort of garment his son would make, And the queen, too, was very anxious as to the result of her experiment. On the third day they sent for the two young men and their work.
